elements.text: Proposed stages from December 2026 through Q4 2027

elements.name: roadmap-summary
elements.text:
Stage	Timing	Compass focus
0  Prototype	Dec 2026	Review inbound voice, intent, recording/transcription,
document retrieval and CSR Chat in Shield Advisor.
1  MVP	Feb 1–28, 2027	Launch self-service intents at the Compass front door.
Intent and summary in CSR Chat within Shield Advisor.
2  Expand intents	Mar–Jun 2027
Monthly releases	Target the Top 20 intents. Q1 discovery scopes candidate
knowledge, case-guidance and drafting extensions.*
3 / 4  Expand
reach*	Q2 discovery
Q3 pilots / Q4 scale	Intelligent routing and predictive engagement.
Digital context and enhanced callbacks. Supervisory copilots
for QM, queues and analytics.

elements.name: roadmap-summary-note
elements.text: *Proposed scope and allocation. CSR workflow coaching is distinct from later supervisory copilots.
